Crime & Law · India

Multiple women found dead across India in separate incidents

Multiple women have been found dead in separate incidents across India. In Kondapur, a woman died after falling from the 12th floor, with police registering a case. Gurugram police arrested a man for allegedly murdering his wife with his girlfriend's help before a planned trip to Nepal. In Khanna, a couple was found dead in a hotel room, with police suspecting murder-suicide. Another woman was found dead in a hotel room in Hyderabad, with her family alleging murder. In east Delhi, a 20-year-old woman allegedly strangled her 19-year-old husband to death after he accused her of an extramarital affair and confiscated her phone. Separately, a woman police officer was found dead in official quarters in Odisha, and in Kangra, a woman and her daughter were found dead.
